messages:
zoe: Customer question: during a canary the route silently fell back and their invoice looked wrong. Console shows one token + cost line. We need clearer per-request attribution + a short playback.

amir: Agreed. Our emitter currently sends a single inference_done event; no per-segment detail. We should emit `inference_segment` with model_id, tokens, segment_index and optional cache_origin.

kelly: For UX: show a compact stacked bar inline in Billing > Requests with per-model colors. Hover shows tokens, unit price, and 'estimate' if attribution is mixed. Include a short "why" note linking to rollout playback.

audit-bot: NOTE: emit `fallback_audit` events for every auto fallback: fields = trace_id, time, from_model, to_model, reason, operator, policy_snapshot_ref.

amir: Edge case: prefix replay + KV cache can cause tokens attributed to host A while host B produced output. Add `attribution_mode` (exact|estimated|mixed_kv) and `estimated_share` when needed.

ben: Billing: final invoice must be reconcilable. Add GET /v1/billing/trace/{id}/official_breakdown that returns signed per-segment counts and rates at serve time. Console "export official" triggers this and creates a signed PDF/CSV.

kelly: Playback UX: tiny chevron next to request opens a timeline: metric trigger -> policy eval -> decision -> model switch -> evidence link. Steps are short, filterable by reason. Redaction badge if evidence is scrubbed.

zoe: Owners: amir (telemetry), kelly (UI), ben (billing), product to write runbook. Next: spike telemetry proto + console mock. I'll file RF-2201 with links.
